PR #415 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/415

**Summary of what shipped** — all 7 findings closed in one PR on `worker/task-20260718-045009-ai-architecture--ai-orchestration--routi`:

1. **Observability** — new `/ai-observability` trace list+detail UI (aggregate analytics already existed, this fills the individual-trace gap).
2. **Routing accuracy** — new weekly-report service computing a real accuracy metric from existing execution data.
3. **HA & Failover** — extended `platformFallbackFor()` for the escalated tier, and fixed a real bug found along the way: `escalatedPlatformConfig()` never wired up a fallback at all, so the escalated tier had zero failover before this change.
4. **Multi-AI Provider Support** — roster.ts is now admin-editable via a DB override layer, wired through all 3 real dispatch surfaces, with a Settings UI.
5. **AI Model Routing audit** — extended Loop 14 with a deterministic missed-escalation sample.
6. **Predictive ML model selection** — no code (per the finding's own guidance), but the "no action needed unless..." decision is now a live, weekly re-evaluated check instead of a stale one-time call.
7. **AI-reduction metric** — new monthly snapshot table/service turning cumulative counters into a real trend.

Verified: `tsc` clean, `eslint` clean, full test suite 1422/1422 passing. PROGRESS.md has full detail, and I registered the claim in `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml`. One thing worth flagging: the two new migrations haven't been applied to a live database yet (no DB access in this session) — that still needs to happen before/at deploy.
